originalProblem: On iOS 17 the archived retailer evidence label was static text. The only actionable element was a 10.5 by 13.5 point chevron without the retailer-history label.
interaction: The full row is a named button at least 44 points high. A single tap on its leading text switched Collapsed to Expanded in both history screens after relaunch.

offerTextBoundary.failure: A retailer offer accepted a quantity literal longer than 2,048 UTF-8 bytes after the local list-import limit was widened.
offerTextBoundary.fix: The ordered amount, required amount and remaining-original amount each retain the retailer-offer limit. All three accept a 2,048-byte multibyte literal and reject 2,049 bytes independently. An 8,192-byte list source remains committable.

integration.logging: The two history walkthroughs used OS_ACTIVITY_MODE=disable for the app process on iOS 17 after a reproduced XCTest snapshot crash inside the runtime-issue logging callback. Other tests used their ordinary configuration.

deviceBuild.configuration: Unsigned Release for generic arm64 iPhone
deviceBuild.verified: Executable, assets, privacy manifest, environment, widget and share extensions.
deviceBuild.distribution: Physical installation and App Store distribution require separate verification.

otherChecks.foundationVerifier: Passed the reference contract and fixture checks.
